import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

for target, source in re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z]+|\d+)", text):
    values[target] = values[source] if source.isalpha() else int(source)

names = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
